company.name: Sanima Reliance Life Insurance Limited
company.mergerHistory: Formed by the merger of Sanima Life Insurance (started operations Dec 2017) and Reliance Life Insurance; joint business began 23 March 2023 (Chaitra 9, 2079 BS).
company.about: Sanima Reliance Life is a Kathmandu-based life insurer formed in 2023 by the merger of Sanima Life and Reliance Life. It sells individual endowment, term, whole-life and child plans plus group and micro products.
highlights: Life insurance fund of about Rs 18.2 arba (Q3 FY 2081/82)
Paid-up capital about Rs 5.01 arba (Q3 FY 2081/82)
Website lists Mero Mutu child plan, Limited Paying Whole Life and Triple Endowment
company.claimSettlementNote: FY 2081/82, by amount: claims paid / (claims paid + claims outstanding), derived by Beema Portal from NIA Annual Report FY 2081/82 schedules 14-15 (NIA publishes no per-company ratio; year-end snapshot, excludes rejected claims). Third-party derived estimate.

policies.name: Endowment Assurance Policy
policies.summary: A savings plan that pays a lump sum at the end of the term, or to your family if you die earlier.
features: Fixed premium over the policy term
Life cover from day one (after underwriting)
Policy loan available after surrender value is acquired
benefits: Maturity benefit paid if you survive the term
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
Death due to concealed pre-existing conditions or false declaration

policies.name: Limited Endowment
policies.summary: Pay premiums for a shorter period while cover and savings continue to maturity.
features: Fixed premium over the policy term
Life cover from day one (after underwriting)
Policy loan available after surrender value is acquired
benefits: Maturity benefit paid if you survive the term
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
Death due to concealed pre-existing conditions or false declaration
bestFor: People who want to finish paying premiums early

policies.name: Triple Endowment
policies.summary: Pays back part of the sum assured at set intervals during the term, with the balance at maturity.
features: Fixed premium over the policy term
Life cover from day one (after underwriting)

benefits: Maturity benefit paid if you survive the term
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year

policies.name: Joint Life Endowment
policies.summary: One endowment policy covering two lives, such as spouses.
features: Fixed premium over the policy term
Life cover from day one (after underwriting)
Policy loan available after surrender value is acquired
benefits: Maturity benefit paid if you survive the term
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year

policies.name: Term Assurance Policy
policies.summary: Low-cost pure protection that pays your family if you die during the term.
features: Lowest premium for the cover
Pure protection with no savings
Fixed premium over the term
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
Death due to concealed pre-existing conditions or false declaration

policies.name: Limited Paying Whole Life
policies.summary: Pay premiums for a limited period and stay covered for life.
features: Fixed premium over the policy term
Life cover from day one (after underwriting)
Policy loan available after surrender value is acquired
benefits: Death benefit paid to nominee whenever death occurs
Survival benefit at the end of the plan age
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
Death due to concealed pre-existing conditions or false declaration

policies.name: Endowment/Whole Life

policies.name: Mero Mutu (Child Plan)
policies.summary: A savings plan to fund your child's future, with cover on the parent.
features: Built around the child's future needs
Premium waiver if the parent dies or is disabled
Lump sum at maturity
benefits: Maturity benefit paid if you survive the term
exclusions: Suicide within the first policy year
Death due to concealed pre-existing conditions or false declaration
bestFor: Parents saving for education or marriage costs
